provenance.section: MarketTrade.price — "Price of the trade", typed as a string with no documented format and no statement that it is always present and non-empty
modifications: trades[0].trade_id changed from "000000000" to "000000042", so this is a different trade from the documented example's and cannot be confused with it inside a dedupe window.

trades[0].price changed from "1260.01" to "". Whether Coinbase ever sends an empty decimal is UNVERIFIED (U-CB-1); the adapter refuses it rather than mapping it to absent or to zero, and this fixture is what pins that refusal.
trades[0].time advanced so the trade is distinguishable from the documented example's.
events[0].type is left as "snapshot", which is the whole point: this is the venue's authoritative statement of current state, and the adapter cannot apply it.

expectation: Parses as a market_trades frame — the wire schema types price as an unconstrained string, so emptiness is a decimal-boundary failure, not a shape failure. Produces NO ReferenceTradeObserved and a COINBASE_ECONOMIC_FIELD_INVALID anomaly. Because the only entry of a snapshot event was refused, the snapshot was not applied: it does NOT mark market_trades resynchronized, it emits COINBASE_SNAPSHOT_NOT_APPLIED, and an open gap stays open.
